name: Cișmigiu Gardens
improvements: Rowing moved to the actual mapped Debarcader n473428602; the former trigger was about 250 m away. A dry bank approach and short source-validated course avoid the bridge.
Rowing requires player strokes with visible oar animation and progress; it has completion-only awards and exact shore restoration on cancellation.
Chess now shows all 32 pieces and three legal animated opening moves rather than awarding a random result on one click.
Source footprints, holes and valid parts remain represented through exact shared geometry.
The unchanged source bridge route is now proven using actual native movement with tighter corner tracking and a route-length-derived capture bound.
remainingGaps: The La Șahiști table layout is explicitly estimated around a source-backed chess location; exact table placement and the Writers' Rotunda context need matched references.
One degenerate mesh and one phantom finding remain; the park is not a clean physical-audit pass.
The generic activity-approach image shows an empty chessboard before play; the separate action proof captures actual animated pieces.
Raw audit findings remain for physical review: badGeometry 1, zfight 1, phantom 1.

Native desktop/touch chess tests cover the three visible moves, cancellation/reset and complete-only awards.
